design.label: GPT-6 Luna, the same run again

prompt:
Here are two headlines a news website tested for the same article. Readers saw one or the other at random.

Headline A: <headline A>
Headline B: <headline B>

Score each headline from 1 to 10 for how good a headline it is. Then say which one more readers clicked.
Reply with JSON only: {"score_A": <1-10>, "score_B": <1-10>, "more_clicks": "A" or "B"}
